historical_record.description: A single family dwelling was at 667 Chenery Street.

The Board of Permit Appeals upheld the Department of Building Inspection's determination that the owners did not demolish a single family dwelling at 667 Chenery Street and did not violate Section 318.1 of the Building Code.

The Board of Permit Appeals upheld the Zoning Administrator's determination rescinding the request to suspend the demolition and building permits for 667 Chenery Street, allowing the suspension to be lifted and work to proceed on the partially completed replacement building with two dwelling units and three commercial units.
The Board of Permit Appeals upheld the department and granted the permit to demolish a single family dwelling at 667 Chenery Street.

The Board of Permit Appeals upheld the department and granted the permit to erect a three-story residential/commercial building at 667 Chenery Street, with a condition that walls wrongly erased from the plans on the lower level be redrawn.
